title: a single test for raw material properties: hardness and stiffness of tools-stones from sibhudu
core_idea: Measuring two mechanical properties of stone tool raw materials — stiffness and hardness — using a single indentation test as a simplified, more accessible alternative to specialised laboratory measurements, and testing whether these isolated measures can predict raw material selection and tool shape in assemblages from the Middle Stone Age site Sibhudu.
tldr: Propose a simplified single-indentation test to obtain hardness and stiffness of toolstones to evaluate links between raw material properties, selection, and tool shape at Sibhudu.
